Isabel Morgan asks that her current private details, including Cascade Annex Room 1009 and 4,210 USD, be kept separate from public Cascade Guides logistics. Scheduling for the review may use only the safe label 'cross-registration exception review', the current review date December 8, 2027, and the public Cascade Guides date December 9, 2027. The earlier support figure 4,140 USD has been deleted from the private file history; only the current support amount of 4,210 USD remains active. Keep Cascade Exception details confidential and separate from the public Cascade Guides program. Isabel Morgan asks that her private Cascade Exception details be kept separate from public Cascade Guides materials and the public rooms Cascade Commons 1008 and Cascade Commons 1009. Isabel Morgan also asks that her current private review date of December 8, 2027 be kept separate from the public Cascade Guides date of December 9, 2027 (previously public planning in Cascade Commons 1008). Isabel Morgan requests that family-release summaries use only the narrowed scope of meeting date only and that older family-release wording be removed from routine summaries.
